director.notes: Fighting passage: only what the tafsirs say with their restrictions (the treaty-holders of that time, the four months, those who broke oaths and attacked); no battle, weapon, captive or killing drawn; no present-day reading. No motif on the Prophet ﷺ. 5:1-4 carries As-Sa'di's restriction (the four months, and the full term for longer treaties). The command itself (5:5-14) is left unglossed: no chip may read as a general call. An hourglass for the months ending, light for repentance, a house for «فأجره», a book for «كلام الله», footsteps for «أبلغه مأمنه». STAGING v4: Fighting and treaty passage: stays ambient (owner rule, Staging v4); nobody is drawn. c1 (5): geometric mood; an hourglass for the months ending (5:1-4), a light plate for their repentance, prayer and zakat (5:15-22, gone before the Name); the background stays quiet on the command 5:5-14, so nothing pulses in rhythm with it. c2 (6): night_sky (a passage on hearing His speech: no central light source); the words addressed to the Prophet (6:5-6, 6:12) carry no plate; a geometric plate for the speech of Allah (6:9-10, His attribute) and the background stays quiet on 6:8-10; a house plate for his place of safety (6:13; As-Sa'di: the place where he is safe).
